title: The man in the Shroud of Turin was alive

tellings.quote: The man in the shroud was living.

related.note: Both are about what the Shroud records of the man in it, but Strieber says it shows a body that had died and turned into light, while this telling says the man was alive.

plain: The man whose image is on the Shroud of Turin, a linen cloth kept in Turin, Italy, said to have wrapped Jesus after the crucifixion, was still alive when he was wrapped in it. The researcher Randall Carlson says this flatly, "The man in the shroud was living," drawing on the cloth and the Gospels, the New Testament books that tell Jesus's life, without naming any other source. If true, it would change the story of a man who is said to have died before burial.
